snippet.title: Emissary Zero - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Co-op horror (1-4 players). You are sent to explore a mysterious building at night. Find the Moon and try to return alive.

Coming 28th March on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3176060/Emissary_Zero
